steps.purpose: Run the semantic layer's key rules (NDC and unit of use) over each hospital's stock, and name the rows they reject.
steps.finding: 11 stock rows across the system fail the NDC rule; 0 of them are this drug. Every row is in a shared unit of use.

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include fluconazole as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 164 tablets of fluconazole 50 mg at 12.8 tablets per day, providing 12.8 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 289 tablets of fluconazole 50 mg at 16.4 tablets per day, providing 17.6 days on hand.
The top-ranked purchasing option is to buy from ANI Pharmaceuticals, Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today.
The second option is to buy from Aurobindo Pharma Limited, also not on FDA's shortage list today.
The third option is to buy from AvPAK, likewise not on FDA's shortage list today.

Check the registered plants on the labels for Golden State Medical Supply, Inc. (FEI 3006458969, last inspection NAI 2025-06-11) and Novitium Pharma LLC (FEI 3012541241, last inspection NAI 2024-02-16) to confirm current compliance status.
